Terminal.msg0: God why wont this thing just work, Ive radiod in about 5 times aleady but the commander just wont respond, i should probably head back to assess my equipment
Terminal.msg1: the hell? the UV marks are gone... those things last for 2 weeks! its been only 2 days! fuck now im lost as shit, i think i remember some of these hallways but they all look the same...
Terminal.msg2: I shot down some entity, it looks like a weird cable-creature made of wires, plastic and other weird electronics, wasn't bulletproof though...
Terminal.msg3: I think im just wandering deeper into the complex, this isnt the way i came from, god im lost as hell, hungry too...
Terminal.msg4: I heard gunfire and I ran to it to find one of the exterminator members being attacked by some...thing. It was an abomination... It didnt see me but i ran as far away as I could from it.
Terminal.msg5: THEY WONT STOP CHASING ME WHAT THE FUCK IVE BEEN RUNNING FOR AN HOUR THEY WONT STOP FUCK FUCK FUCK FUCK FUCK

Terminal.msg0: Its been probably 12 days since I fell into the place, at least I think so, its hard to tell what time it is when theres no clocks or anything, just halls.
Terminal.msg1: I havent eaten in days, theres a body in the next hall...Food is hard to come by in this place, god forgive me.
Terminal.msg2: thats the 4th time ive seen something in the shadows, i think its stalking me... or I'm just going crazy but I sware to god it looks like eyes and a hand reaching around the corner...watching
Terminal.msg3: FUCK THAT WAS NOT A SHADOW THAT WAS NOT A SHADOW WHAT WAS THAT OH MY GOD PLEASE DONT FIND ME PLEASE DONT FIND ME DEAR GOD IT HAD NO FACE ONLY EYES
Terminal.msg4: I think I lost it, it hasn't found me but i hear footsteps from time to time and grunting, its looking for me for sure. I might have to sit here for a few days until it leaves me alone

Terminal.msg1: Already off to a rough start, within minutes of exiting the threshold we already lost one of our expedition members
Terminal.msg2: Analysis of the site revealed a hidden trap gun, we cant tell much more other than its still functional and still active
Terminal.msg5: I had to leave Johnson behind, he became deathly ill after walking around a corner and something blew up chemicals in his face, mightve been radioactive, he passed out and I cant carry him back.
Terminal.msg6: I'm trying to use a crowbar I found to check corners for traps, what kind of sadistic fucker places traps in a place like this, and how they get the materials for them is beyond my understanding
Terminal.msg7: SOME GUY SHOT ME. they just came around a corner all mad and naked with a gun and started firing, he hit my hip and im trying to limp back to security, he ran after I returned fire... what the fuck...

Terminal.msg0: I was never very religious, but god damn I'm really starting to reconsider
Terminal.msg1: If hell was a place, this would be it, wherever this place is at least... all I see is blood and dull colored walls and never ending passageways
Terminal.msg2: not to mention the....interesting things you find down here, half the time you want to jump for joy and celebrate being able to live a little while longer, othertimes you want to vomit
Terminal.msg3: maybe I'm already dead, but I thought I was pretty good in life
Terminal.msg4: I'm thinking God is just an asshole

Terminal.msg0: They forced me to set up the traps, they dont leave me alone...i thought if I did what they wanted they would leave me alone
Terminal.msg1: all they do now is scream
(redacted) is added to (redacted), threshold appears to (redacted), new entrance to the backrooms is opened.
Terminal.msg2: 3 members sent in, this section of the backrooms appears to be darkened and in some disrepair, but mostly the same
Terminal.msg3: new backrooms section appears to contain high levels of activity and (redacted), caution advised, all future travels will be done armed
Terminal.msg4: lifesigns of 2 members have ceased after eradic vital changes due to presumed injuries, communications cease
Terminal.msg5: last member of expedition returnes to threshold, he sustained a puncture wound extending through his entire skull, recieved likely permenant mental impairment
